reviews.review:
Warframe is an extremely addicting game that allows the use of futuristic weaponry to obliterate all of those who stand in your way. For a free to play, this game allows you get equiptment that you might usually need to spend real money on. The game also includes a vast amount of customization from what weapons you use, how they look and how well they preform in combat. The bosses all have unique characteristics about them and the weapons and warframes to choose from makes it quite difficult to find someome who has the same loadout as you. Playing by yourself or cooperating with others gives you 2 different approaches to the game and only experiencing both will give you the best view. The (somewhat) interactive maps, skills and randomly generated maps (I believe) increase the epicness of this game. 
     Although this is a good game, the maps can sometimes be quite repetitive and dont have many unique aspects to them and the mobs you face tend to be as well. The bosses you face, however, are quite different in how they fight and what their weaknesses are. 
     The gameplay can be similar to many mob grinding games, killing enemies, collecting data and sabotaging key points while levering up your equiptment. You can explore the maps and find materials and resources needed to build newer and more exciting things. As you kill your enemies, they sometimes drop these tablets called mods. These mods can upgrade ur equiptment by increasing damage, reload speed, fire rate ect or can apply new effects like frost, fire or electric damage. As the level of your equiptment rises, the more upgrades you can apply to them. Mods can also be fused together with others to make your starting mod stronger at the cost of a higher energy cost. You can also combind unwanted mods together to create different mods you may want. 
     Overall, this game is one of the best free to play games I have ever seen a high level of excitement and customization options making me come back for more every time. It is a very well thought out and addicting game that exceeds all my expectations for free to play and pay to play games.
